base_rate_rules: Most dissolutions are self-dug (capacity wave + demand miss), not architectural. Weight supply-response kills ~2x vs architecture kills.
Crowded bottleneck equities unwind 70-99% peak-to-trough; commodity legs fall 80-95%.
First kill-signal to trough typically runs 1-4 years. Shorts need defined risk and a carry plan, not just correctness.
Bankruptcies cluster in leveraged pure-play overbuilders (Suntech, SunEdison, Molycorp). Purity kills on the way down as it pays on the way up.
True architectural dissolution (Sun/Linux-x86) is rarer but total: no recovery, business model gone.
name: dissolution precedents (calibration set)

precedents.digger: DWDM capacity wave + demand stall (self-dug); most fiber went dark
precedents.lesson: The shovel glut IS the digger. Overbuild dissolves faster than any new tech.
precedents.peak_evidence: Optical components priced as if all fiber would light

precedents.digger: Chinese capacity 10x (2008-2012) + EU subsidy cuts + financial crisis (self-dug)
precedents.drawdown: Poly $475/kg (Apr 2008) -> $55 (-88%, Jul 2009) -> $16; Suntech bankrupt Mar 2013; SunEdison 2016
precedents.lesson: Long-term fixed-price supply contracts signed at the top become death warrants. Purity + leverage = bankruptcy.

precedents.crowded_vehicle: Albemarle / SQM / Pilbara at record multiples
precedents.digger: Chinese supply wave + EV demand growth miss (self-dug)
precedents.drawdown: Carbonate -80%+ from late-2022 highs; ALB ~$335 -> ~$86 (~-74%); surplus guided into late decade
precedents.lesson: Closest live rhyme for memory: same structure (shortage -> vertical integration rush -> supply wave). Watch spodumene/auction pricing as the spot-price kill feed.

precedents.crowded_vehicle: Micron / Samsung / Hynix capex; customers double-ordering
precedents.digger: Inventory overhang + smartphone/datacenter demand pause (self-dug, cyclical)
precedents.drawdown: NAND -25% in Q1-19 alone; DRAM sales halved; MU ~-50% Sep-Dec 2018; 5% production cuts
precedents.lesson: Memory has dissolved on schedule for 40 years. The 2019 playbook (cuts restore, ~18 months) is the bull case; the bear case is this time the demand was pulled forward by AI.

precedents.crowded_vehicle: Molycorp IPO ($14 -> $79) on China export quotas
precedents.digger: China supply return + substitution + demand normalization
precedents.lesson: Geopolitical bottlenecks dissolve politically as well as physically. Never short-squeeze-proof a story stock without puts.

precedents.drawdown: SUNW -85% to $9.50 Oracle takeout 2010; never recovered
precedents.lesson: The rare case where the digger was real architecture, not overbuild. Total, permanent, no bounce. This is the template for 'chatgpt8 doesn't need memory'.
precedents.peak_evidence: Proprietary UNIX servers as internet shovels

precedents.crowded_vehicle: NVDA gaming-channel inventory on mining demand
precedents.digger: Crypto crash = demand evaporation (later finished by proof-of-stake)
precedents.drawdown: NVDA ~-50% in Q4 2018 on channel glut
precedents.lesson: Picks-and-shovels demand can vanish in a quarter when the end market is speculative. Demand-evaporation kills are the fastest dissolutions.

precedents.digger: None needed — capability never matched narrative (expectation collapse)
precedents.lesson: Some crowded shovels dissolve without any digger at all. Narrative premium alone can be the entire long thesis.

precedents.digger: Kryder's law: areal density gains repeatedly dissolved each shortage (self-dissolving bottleneck)
precedents.drawdown: Industry-level: near-total maker extinction over two decades
precedents.lesson: Some bottlenecks dissolve themselves through their own learning curve. Survivors consolidate to oligopoly — the long game is owning the consolidator, the short game is fading maker #12.
precedents.peak_evidence: Repeated shortage panics, each lower than the last
